children: Round-up of South Korean financial markets:

** South Korean shares recovered from early losses to end 1% higher on Thursday on a rebound in chipmakers, as the country became the fourth in the world to hit the $1 trillion milestone in annual exports.
** The index turned higher as Japan's Nikkei and US stock futures also extended gains during Asian trading hours.

** South Korea's exports so far for this year have exceeded $1 trillion, driven by a global AI chip boom, making it the fourth country in the world to reach the milestone after Germany, the United States and China.

** South Korean entertainment stocks rallied after a trade deal between the country and China in the services sector raised hopes for an easing of China's decade-old unofficial restrictions on South Korean entertainment content.

** Of the total 912 traded issues, 522 shares advanced, while 348 declined.
** Foreigners were net sellers of shares worth 425.9 billion won ($319.99 million).

** In money and debt markets, December futures on three-year treasury bonds (KTBc1) gained 0.07 point to 103.53.
